features.label: Dynamic 3d motiontech knit
features.text: Micro-engineered MotionTech yarn provides a skintight, compressive fit that enhances joint stability and proprioception without the bulk of a standard buttress

features.label: Advanced coolvent technology
features.text: Specialized CoolVent knit in the popliteal area behind the knee maximizes breathability and superior moisture wicking to keep skin dry during intense activity

features.label: Secure foldlock system
features.text: Patented FoldLock top and bottom edges work seamlessly with StayBilizer technology to ensure the sleeve will not slip or roll down

features.label: Lightweight spiral steel stays
features.text: Removable spiral steel stays offer flexible medial and lateral reinforcement for comfortable, everyday support

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with US-based brace specialists.

measurement: Requires TWO measurements: calf circumference 6 in. below mid-patella and thigh circumference 6 in. above mid-patella. Leg in extension for both. Both measurements must fall within the same size range. If measurements span two sizes, choose the size that matches the thigh measurement. Measure on bare skin. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
